note: Where each checklist entry is, written for this project (no guide text). title: a short name for Gold Skulltula and heart piece rows (shown as '<area>: <title>'). where: one or two sentences. Keyed by checklist id.

heart_pieces.001.title: Man on the roof
heart_pieces.001.where: A man lying on a rooftop gives it to you. As a child, carry a Cucco up to the ledge behind the windmill and glide over; as an adult, Hookshot up.

heart_pieces.002.title: Dampé's gravedigging tour
heart_pieces.002.where: As a child at night, pay Dampé to dig in the graveyard's soft ground. Keep paying for digs until the piece turns up.

heart_pieces.003.title: Inside the stone tower
heart_pieces.003.where: As a child, push the crates aside in the ranch's stone tower and crawl through to the round room behind them.

heart_pieces.004.title: Chest on the Cucco ledge
heart_pieces.004.where: In a chest on a ledge partway down the valley. Glide there with a Cucco as a child, or Longshot over as an adult.

heart_pieces.005.title: Behind the waterfall
heart_pieces.005.where: On a ledge behind the waterfall near the valley's entrance. Drop down to it from the path above.

heart_pieces.006.title: Fishing pond (child prize)
heart_pieces.006.where: Catch a big enough fish as a child at the fishing pond by Lake Hylia.

heart_pieces.007.title: Richard the lost dog
heart_pieces.007.where: As a child at night, find the dog Richard running around the back alley and lead him home to his owner.

heart_pieces.008.title: Skull Kid's ocarina game
heart_pieces.008.where: As a child, stand on the stump near the entrance to the Lost Woods and repeat the Skull Kid's tunes. Win three rounds.

heart_pieces.009.title: Skull Kid's song
heart_pieces.009.where: As a child, play Saria's Song for the Skull Kid sitting on a stump in the Lost Woods.

heart_pieces.010.title: Spinning pot
heart_pieces.010.where: As a child, light every torch on Goron City's bottom floor, then drop a Bomb (or a Bomb Flower) into the big spinning pot.

heart_pieces.011.title: Ledge below the crater entrance
heart_pieces.011.where: From the summit entrance, climb down the wall to a hidden ledge. A child can grab it before the heat gets too much; as an adult, wear the Goron Tunic.

heart_pieces.012.title: Rooftop behind Impa's house
heart_pieces.012.where: On the roof above Impa's cow pen. As a child, let Kaepora Gaebora carry you down from the Death Mountain summit (he only offers once you have Din's Fire); as an adult, Hookshot up.

heart_pieces.013.title: Bombchu Bowling
heart_pieces.013.where: One of the prizes at the Bombchu Bowling Alley. The alley opens after you defeat King Dodongo.

heart_pieces.014.title: Raised platform
heart_pieces.014.where: On top of a pillar near the start of the river. Glide there with a Cucco as a child, or use the Hover Boots as an adult.

heart_pieces.015.title: Ledge by the waterfall
heart_pieces.015.where: On a ledge near the waterfall to Zora's Domain. Glide there with a Cucco as a child, or use the Hover Boots as an adult.

heart_pieces.016.title: Torch chest
heart_pieces.016.where: Light every torch around Zora's Domain with a burning Deku Stick to make a chest appear.

heart_pieces.017.title: Magic Bean platform
heart_pieces.017.where: Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil by the graveyard wall as a child, then ride the plant as an adult to the platform with the piece.

heart_pieces.018.title: Inside the windmill
heart_pieces.018.where: On a ledge high inside the windmill. As a child, the Boomerang can fetch it; as an adult, come up through the tunnel from Dampé's grave.

heart_pieces.019.title: Dampé's race
heart_pieces.019.where: As an adult, race Dampé's ghost through his tomb in under a minute. The chest at the end holds the piece.

heart_pieces.020.title: House of Skulltula: 50 tokens
heart_pieces.020.where: The reward for bringing 50 Gold Skulltula tokens to the House of Skulltula.

heart_pieces.021.title: Laboratory roof
heart_pieces.021.where: On the roof of the Lakeside Laboratory. Ride the Magic Bean planted beside the lab as an adult, or use the Scarecrow's Song with the Hookshot.

heart_pieces.022.title: Laboratory diving game
heart_pieces.022.where: Reach the bottom of the laboratory's deep pool for the scientist. You'll need the Golden Scale.

heart_pieces.023.title: Above Dodongo's Cavern
heart_pieces.023.where: On a ledge above the cavern entrance. Plant a Magic Bean in the soil there as a child and ride it as an adult.

heart_pieces.024.title: Bean pillar
heart_pieces.024.where: On a tall pillar in the middle of the crater. Plant a Magic Bean in the crater's soil as a child (warp in with the Bolero of Fire), then ride it as an adult.

heart_pieces.025.title: Iceberg
heart_pieces.025.where: As an adult, hop across the floating ice to the farthest iceberg in Zora's Fountain.

heart_pieces.026.title: Bottom of the fountain
heart_pieces.026.where: As an adult, sink to the bottom of Zora's Fountain with the Iron Boots, wearing the Zora Tunic.

heart_pieces.027.title: Frogs: Song of Storms
heart_pieces.027.where: As a child, play the Song of Storms to the frogs on the log in Zora's River.

heart_pieces.028.title: Frogs: bug-catching game
heart_pieces.028.where: As a child, play all six of the frogs' songs, then win their bug-catching game.

heart_pieces.029.title: Treasure Chest Shop
heart_pieces.029.where: As a child at night, win the Treasure Chest Shop's game. The Lenses of Truth show which chests to open.

heart_pieces.030.title: Rooftop chest
heart_pieces.030.where: In a chest on a high rooftop of the fortress. Get there with the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot, the Longshot or the Hover Boots.

heart_pieces.031.title: Horseback archery
heart_pieces.031.where: Score 1,000 points at the Gerudo horseback archery range, riding Epona.

heart_pieces.032.title: Bean platform
heart_pieces.032.where: Plant a Magic Bean in the soil by the Spirit Temple as a child (warp in with the Requiem of Spirit), then ride it as an adult to the piece.

heart_pieces.033.title: Hidden grave chest
heart_pieces.033.where: Pull back one of the graveyard's gravestones (as a child, only at night) and drop into the grave. The chest is at the end.

heart_pieces.034.title: Password Business Scrub
heart_pieces.034.where: As an adult, read the Fairy Note on the tree near the castle drawbridge for a password. Then, as a child, bomb the cracked ground nearby and buy the piece from the scrub for 100 Rupees.

heart_pieces.035.title: Chest by the Gerudo Valley road
heart_pieces.035.where: As an adult, read the Fairy Note beside the chest under the red cliffs near Gerudo Valley. Then open the chest as a child.

heart_pieces.036.title: Business Scrub
heart_pieces.036.where: As a child, from the summit entrance go left and drop down to the ledge below. The scrub there sells the piece for 100 Rupees.

gold_skulltulas.001.title: Compass room alcove
gold_skulltulas.001.where: On the third floor, in the alcove the raised platforms lead to, near the Compass chest.

gold_skulltulas.002.title: Basement vines
gold_skulltulas.002.where: On the vine wall in the basement. Knock it down with the Slingshot or the Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.003.title: By the webbed grate
gold_skulltulas.003.where: In the basement, next to the grate covered by a spider web.

gold_skulltulas.004.title: Back room
gold_skulltulas.004.where: In the basement's back room: burn the web, bomb the wall behind it and fetch the token with the Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.005.title: Guard house crate
gold_skulltulas.005.where: As a child, roll into the crate in the guard house storeroom by the town gate.

gold_skulltulas.006.title: Garden palm tree
gold_skulltulas.006.where: As a child, roll into the palm tree in the garden at the foot of the castle wall.

gold_skulltulas.007.title: House under construction
gold_skulltulas.007.where: As a child at night, on the brick wall of the unfinished house.

gold_skulltulas.008.title: House of Skulltula wall
gold_skulltulas.008.where: As a child at night, on the wall beside the House of Skulltula's door.

gold_skulltulas.009.title: Village square tree
gold_skulltulas.009.where: As a child at night, roll into the tall tree in the village square.

gold_skulltulas.010.title: Watchtower ladder
gold_skulltulas.010.where: As a child at night, near the top of the watchtower ladder. Shoot it down with the Slingshot, then climb up.

gold_skulltulas.011.title: Soft soil
gold_skulltulas.011.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil by the graveyard wall.

gold_skulltulas.012.title: Wall by the gate
gold_skulltulas.012.where: As a child at night, under the eaves of the house near the gate to Death Mountain.

gold_skulltulas.013.title: Tree near the silo
gold_skulltulas.013.where: As a child, roll into the tree by the stone wall near the ranch's silo.

gold_skulltulas.014.title: Soft soil
gold_skulltulas.014.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil by the barrels at the lakeside house.

gold_skulltulas.015.title: Soft soil by the waterfall
gold_skulltulas.015.where: As a child, glide with a Cucco into the cave beside the waterfall and drop bugs on the soil there.

gold_skulltulas.016.title: Tree by the Know-It-All house
gold_skulltulas.016.where: As a child at night, on the big tree trunk beside the houses.

gold_skulltulas.017.title: Soft soil by the bridge
gold_skulltulas.017.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil near the first Business Scrub.

gold_skulltulas.018.title: Soft soil by the theater
gold_skulltulas.018.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil by the second Business Scrub, near the Deku Theater.

gold_skulltulas.019.title: Soft soil by the shop
gold_skulltulas.019.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil behind the Kokiri Shop.

gold_skulltulas.020.title: Soft soil by Dodongo's Cavern
gold_skulltulas.020.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soil in the little cave by the cavern entrance. The boulder in front of it breaks with a Bomb Flower, which needs the Goron's Bracelet.

gold_skulltulas.021.title: Vine wall above the stairs
gold_skulltulas.021.where: On the climbing net above the stone stairs. Kill it with a ranged weapon, then climb up for the token.

gold_skulltulas.022.title: Side room in the south-east
gold_skulltulas.022.where: In the small side room off the first floor's south-east corner.

gold_skulltulas.023.title: Behind a bombable wall
gold_skulltulas.023.where: On the upper floor, in a side room with Dodongos behind a cracked wall. Bomb the wall to get in.

gold_skulltulas.024.title: Room behind the block
gold_skulltulas.024.where: On the first floor: push the block away from the cracked wall, bomb it open and find the Skulltula on the back wall.

gold_skulltulas.025.title: Entrance alcove crate
gold_skulltulas.025.where: As a child, in the first alcove on the right inside the crater, by a crate.

gold_skulltulas.026.title: Cave behind a cracked rock
gold_skulltulas.026.where: Bomb the cracked rock by the trail above Kakariko to open a small cave.

gold_skulltulas.027.title: Boulder maze crate
gold_skulltulas.027.where: As a child, bomb your way into the side cave in Goron City's boulder maze and break the crate.

gold_skulltulas.028.title: Soft soil by the Bean Seller
gold_skulltulas.028.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil next to the Bean Seller.

gold_skulltulas.029.title: Below the crest stone
gold_skulltulas.029.where: As a child at night, under the overhang near the river's crest stone, by the vines.

gold_skulltulas.030.title: Big tree
gold_skulltulas.030.where: As a child, roll into the big tree by the path in the south-east of the fountain.

gold_skulltulas.031.title: Above the pot room
gold_skulltulas.031.where: On the first basement floor, at the top of the vine wall leading to a room with three pots.

gold_skulltulas.032.title: Cavern ceiling
gold_skulltulas.032.where: On the ceiling of the first basement's dripping cavern. Bring it down with the Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.033.title: Dark archway
gold_skulltulas.033.where: Past the cavern ceiling one, in the dark passage towards Big Octo's room. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.034.title: Vine pillar
gold_skulltulas.034.where: On top of a vine-wrapped pillar in a passage on the second floor.

gold_skulltulas.035.title: Cliff above the log
gold_skulltulas.035.where: As a child at night, on the mossy cliff wall. Stand on the slanted ruin south-west of Jabu-Jabu and use the Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.036.title: Laboratory wall
gold_skulltulas.036.where: As a child at night, on the stone wall of the Lakeside Laboratory. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.037.title: House window
gold_skulltulas.037.where: As a child at night, on the ranch house wall beside the entrance arch. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.038.title: Stone tower vines
gold_skulltulas.038.where: At night, in the vines inside the stone tower near the roof. Boomerang as a child, Hookshot as an adult.

gold_skulltulas.039.title: Grotto in the southern woods
gold_skulltulas.039.where: In a grotto in the woods south of Lon Lon Ranch. Blow open its entrance, deal with the big Skulltula, then fetch the gold one with the Boomerang or Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.040.title: Under the small bridge
gold_skulltulas.040.where: As a child at night, on the stone wall by the river channel under the wooden bridge. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.041.title: Behind Dampé's hut
gold_skulltulas.041.where: As a child at night, on the wall behind Dampé's hut. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.042.title: Lone tree
gold_skulltulas.042.where: Roll into the lone tree where the river ends, west of the Kokiri Forest entrance.

gold_skulltulas.043.title: Ruined archway
gold_skulltulas.043.where: As an adult, on the ruined archway along the road to the castle. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.044.title: Behind the House of the Twins
gold_skulltulas.044.where: As an adult at night, on the big tree behind the House of the Twins. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.045.title: Ledge above the bean plant
gold_skulltulas.045.where: As an adult at night, on a high ledge. Ride the Magic Bean plant from the soil by the second Business Scrub.

gold_skulltulas.046.title: Maze dead end
gold_skulltulas.046.where: As an adult at night, high on the wall at a dead end of the meadow's maze. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.047.title: First room vines
gold_skulltulas.047.where: On the vines in the temple's first room. Hookshot it from the branch before the tunnel.

gold_skulltulas.048.title: Main hall landing
gold_skulltulas.048.where: High on the wall above the landing off the main hall. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.049.title: Ivy room
gold_skulltulas.049.where: In the ivy-covered room after the pool room. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.050.title: Basement web corridor
gold_skulltulas.050.where: In the basement, behind a web in a dusty passage. Burn the web to reach it.

gold_skulltulas.051.title: Courtyard scarecrow ledge
gold_skulltulas.051.where: On a high ledge in the east courtyard. Play the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot to the scarecrow.

gold_skulltulas.052.title: Cave above the scarecrow
gold_skulltulas.052.where: As an adult, in a small cave above the scarecrow. Play the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot up, or use the Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.053.title: Mesh walkway
gold_skulltulas.053.where: As an adult, high on the lava cave wall seen from the metal walkway. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.054.title: Soft soil on the lava rim
gold_skulltulas.054.where: As a child, warp in with the Bolero of Fire and drop bugs on the soil by the lava.

gold_skulltulas.055.title: Tile room idol
gold_skulltulas.055.where: Behind the Song of Time block, in the square-tiled room. Bomb the stone idol on the back wall.

gold_skulltulas.056.title: Boulder maze wall
gold_skulltulas.056.where: In the boulder maze: bomb the cracked wall and the Skulltula is behind it.

gold_skulltulas.057.title: Boulder pile
gold_skulltulas.057.where: Smash the pile of rocks with the Megaton Hammer.

gold_skulltulas.058.title: Top of the scarecrow climb
gold_skulltulas.058.where: Play the Scarecrow's Song, Hookshot up to the scarecrow and climb to the corridor at the top.

gold_skulltulas.059.title: Lava room wall
gold_skulltulas.059.where: Past the scarecrow climb, on the wall at the edge of the lava room. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.060.title: Cave past the net slope
gold_skulltulas.060.where: As an adult at night, in the cave past the net slope near the summit. Break the rock with the Megaton Hammer.

gold_skulltulas.061.title: Dark tunnel
gold_skulltulas.061.where: As an adult at night, in the dark tunnel towards Goron City. Break the rock with the Megaton Hammer.

gold_skulltulas.062.title: Rocky ledge
gold_skulltulas.062.where: As an adult at night, on the cliff above a rocky ledge over the water. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.063.title: Frozen bridge pillar
gold_skulltulas.063.where: As an adult at night, on a pillar by the frozen bridge. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.064.title: First room
gold_skulltulas.064.where: High on the wall of the cavern's first big room, with the spinning blade. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.065.title: Sliding block room
gold_skulltulas.065.where: On the ceiling of the room with the sliding ice-block puzzle. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.066.title: Past the Compass chest
gold_skulltulas.066.where: High on the ice wall just past the Compass chest. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.067.title: Rock arch
gold_skulltulas.067.where: As an adult at night, under the rock arch by the canyon path. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.068.title: Laboratory cellar
gold_skulltulas.068.where: As an adult, in the laboratory's deep pool. Sink with the Iron Boots and Hookshot it.

gold_skulltulas.069.title: Flooded cave
gold_skulltulas.069.where: Past the Longshot chest, follow the water passage to a dark flooded cave. Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.070.title: Central pillar
gold_skulltulas.070.where: Up in the chamber inside the central pillar. Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.071.title: Behind the waterfall
gold_skulltulas.071.where: In the boulder corridor by the Boss Key room, hidden behind a small waterfall. Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.072.title: Basement hall
gold_skulltulas.072.where: In the flooded basement under the central room. Sink there with the Iron Boots.

gold_skulltulas.073.title: Shell Blade room
gold_skulltulas.073.where: On the middle floor, in the room behind a cracked wall where the Shell Blades are. Break the wall to get in.

gold_skulltulas.074.title: Big tree hollow
gold_skulltulas.074.where: As an adult at night, in the hollow of the big dead tree on the lake's island. Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.075.title: Song of Storms grotto
gold_skulltulas.075.where: As a child, play the Song of Storms by the tree near Talon's dead end to open a grotto, bomb the wall inside and use the Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.076.title: Like Like room
gold_skulltulas.076.where: On the wall of the torch-lit room with the Like Like. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.077.title: Dark corridor
gold_skulltulas.077.where: Behind the first locked door, at the far end of a dark corridor. The Lenses of Truth show it; the Boomerang fetches it.

gold_skulltulas.078.title: Skull niche crypt
gold_skulltulas.078.where: Behind the second locked door, above the skull niches in the crypt. Lenses of Truth and Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.079.title: Chest room past the eye door
gold_skulltulas.079.where: Above the chest in the room behind an eye door.

gold_skulltulas.080.title: Falling spikes room
gold_skulltulas.080.where: Beside the bars in the room with the falling spiked ceilings.

gold_skulltulas.081.title: Fan corridor
gold_skulltulas.081.where: At the end of the dark corridor with fans in the ceiling. Longshot.

gold_skulltulas.082.title: Scarecrow before the boat
gold_skulltulas.082.where: Before boarding the boat: play the Scarecrow's Song and Longshot up to the scarecrow.

gold_skulltulas.083.title: Skull pots after the boat
gold_skulltulas.083.where: After the boat ride: blow up the three skull pots with Bombs and the last one releases it.

gold_skulltulas.084.title: Ruin by the tents
gold_skulltulas.084.where: As an adult at night, on the ruined wall beside the carpenters' tents. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.085.title: Rooftop tower
gold_skulltulas.085.where: As an adult at night, on a tower wall reached across the fortress rooftops.

gold_skulltulas.086.title: Underground ruin
gold_skulltulas.086.where: As an adult, in the red-lit room under the desert's ruined building. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.087.title: Cliff past the temple
gold_skulltulas.087.where: At night, on the rock face north-west of the Spirit Temple. Longshot as an adult, Boomerang as a child.

gold_skulltulas.088.title: Soft soil by the temple
gold_skulltulas.088.where: As a child, drop bugs on the soft soil by the Spirit Temple wall.

gold_skulltulas.089.title: Archery range target
gold_skulltulas.089.where: As an adult at night, on a target pole at the horseback archery range. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.090.title: Rock pillar
gold_skulltulas.090.where: As an adult at night, on top of a rock pillar across the sand. Ride the Magic Bean plant, or Longshot it.

gold_skulltulas.091.title: Metal fence
gold_skulltulas.091.where: Child side: on the metal fence in the first-floor room with the grating. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.092.title: Stair passage ceiling
gold_skulltulas.092.where: Child side: on the ceiling of the passage above the stairs, after the small key chest. Boomerang.

gold_skulltulas.093.title: Statue room corner
gold_skulltulas.093.where: In a corner of the giant statue room, beside the statue.

gold_skulltulas.094.title: Song of Time alcove
gold_skulltulas.094.where: Adult side: play the Song of Time at the blue block in the boulder room to reveal an alcove.

gold_skulltulas.095.title: Statue's hand
gold_skulltulas.095.where: Adult side: on the giant statue's hand. Play the Scarecrow's Song and Longshot to the scarecrow.

gold_skulltulas.096.title: Roof of Impa's house
gold_skulltulas.096.where: As an adult at night, on the wall above Impa's house roof. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.097.title: Footbridge overlook
gold_skulltulas.097.where: As an adult at night, seen from the mossy overlook by the stone footbridge. Hookshot.

gold_skulltulas.098.title: Tunnel on the south-west shore
gold_skulltulas.098.where: As a child, at the end of a low tunnel on the lake's south-west shore.

gold_skulltulas.099.title: Marsh grotto crate
gold_skulltulas.099.where: Bomb open the grotto by the marsh south-east of Lon Lon Ranch. Kill the Skulltula there as a child; as an adult, break the crate inside for the gold one.

gold_skulltulas.100.title: Snowfield cave
gold_skulltulas.100.where: As an adult at night, lift the silver boulder, cross the snowfield and enter the second cave. The Lenses of Truth show the way; Hookshot the token.

heart_containers.heart_container_gohma.where: Left behind by Gohma, the boss of the Great Deku Tree.

heart_containers.heart_container_king_do.where: Left behind by King Dodongo, the boss of Dodongo's Cavern.

heart_containers.heart_container_barinad.where: Left behind by Barinade, the boss of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

heart_containers.heart_container_phantom.where: Left behind by Phantom Ganon, the boss of the Forest Temple.

heart_containers.heart_container_volvagi.where: Left behind by Volvagia, the boss of the Fire Temple.

heart_containers.heart_container_morpha.where: Left behind by Morpha, the boss of the Water Temple.

heart_containers.heart_container_bongo.where: Left behind by Bongo Bongo, the boss of the Shadow Temple.

heart_containers.heart_container_twinrov.where: Left behind by Twinrova, the boss of the Spirit Temple.

songs.zeldas_lullaby.where: Impa teaches it in Hyrule Castle's courtyard after you meet Princess Zelda.

songs.suns_song.where: Carved on the wall at the end of the Royal Family's Tomb in the graveyard. Zelda's Lullaby opens the tomb.

songs.eponas_song.where: Malon teaches it at Lon Lon Ranch once Talon is back home.

songs.sarias_song.where: Saria teaches it in the Sacred Forest Meadow, after you've met Zelda.

songs.song_of_time.where: Zelda teaches it at the castle moat as she flees, once you have all three Spiritual Stones.

songs.song_of_storms.where: The man in the Kakariko windmill teaches it to you as an adult.

songs.minuet_of_forest.where: Sheik teaches it in the Sacred Forest Meadow.

songs.prelude_of_light.where: Sheik teaches it in the Temple of Time after the Forest Temple.

songs.bolero_of_fire.where: Sheik teaches it in Death Mountain Crater.

songs.serenade_of_water.where: Sheik teaches it at the end of the Ice Cavern.

songs.nocturne_of_shadow.where: Sheik teaches it in Kakariko Village after the Forest, Fire and Water Temples.

songs.requiem_of_spirit.where: Sheik teaches it at the entrance of the Spirit Temple in the Desert Colossus.

songs.scarecrows_song.where: Play a tune of your own for the scarecrow at Lake Hylia as a child, then play it back to him as an adult.

equipment.kokiri_sword.where: In a chest in Kokiri Forest's training area, through the small crawlspace.

equipment.master_sword.where: In the Temple of Time, behind the Door of Time. Opening it needs the three Spiritual Stones and the Song of Time.

equipment.giants_knife.where: Sold by Medigoron in Goron City to an adult.

equipment.biggorons_sword.where: Biggoron on the Death Mountain summit forges it at the end of the adult trading quest.

equipment.hylian_shield.where: In a chest in one of the graveyard's graves, or sold in Castle Town.

equipment.mirror_shield.where: In the Spirit Temple, on the adult side.

equipment.kokiri_tunic_heros_clothes.where: You start the game wearing it.

equipment.goron_tunic.where: Given or sold in Goron City once you've stopped the rolling Goron as an adult.

equipment.zora_tunic.where: King Zora gives it as an adult once you thaw him with Blue Fire.

equipment.iron_boots.where: In the Ice Cavern, after defeating the White Wolfos.

items.fire_arrow.where: After the Water Temple, shoot an arrow into the rising sun from Lake Hylia's island.

items.ice_arrow.where: At the end of the Gerudo Training Ground.

items.light_arrow.where: Zelda gives them in the Temple of Time once you have the Shadow and Spirit Medallions.

items.hookshot.where: In the chest at the end of Dampé's race through his tomb, as an adult.

items.longshot.where: In the Water Temple, after Dark Link.

items.gorons_bracelet.where: Darunia gives it in Goron City after you play Saria's Song for him.

items.silver_gauntlets.where: In the Spirit Temple, found by young Link on the child side.

items.golden_gauntlets.where: In Ganon's Castle, in the Shadow trial area. The Lenses of Truth show the way.

items.bombchus.where: From the Bombchu Shop in Castle Town (open at night after King Dodongo), Bombchu Bowling, or the 40-token Skulltula reward.

items.deku_sticks.where: From the Deku Babas around Kokiri Forest, or the Kokiri Shop.

items.deku_nuts.where: Around Kokiri Forest and the Great Deku Tree, or the Kokiri Shop.

items.dins_fire.where: The Great Fairy on the Death Mountain summit gives it. She's the first fairy you can meet.

items.farores_wind.where: The Great Fairy at Zora's Fountain gives it.

items.nayrus_love.where: The Great Fairy at the Desert Colossus gives it.

items.double_magic.where: The Great Fairy in Death Mountain Crater doubles your magic.

items.lenses_of_truth.where: At the bottom of the Bottom of the Well, after defeating Dead Hand.

items.silver_scale.where: The prize of the diving game in Zora's Domain, as a child.

items.golden_scale.where: The adult prize at the fishing pond by Lake Hylia.

items.echo_gem.where: The reward for 20 Gold Skulltula tokens at the House of Skulltula. It helps you find Gold Skulltulas.

items.fairy_ocarina.where: Saria gives it to you on the bridge as you leave Kokiri Forest.

items.ocarina_of_time.where: Zelda leaves it in the castle moat as she flees, once you have all three Spiritual Stones.

items.magic_bean.where: Sold by the Bean Seller in Zora's River.

key_items.gerudo_membership_card.where: Given at Gerudo Fortress once you've freed all four carpenters.

masks.keaton_mask.where: Borrow it from the Happy Mask Shop and sell it to the guard at Kakariko's gate to Death Mountain.

masks.skull_mask.where: Borrow it from the Happy Mask Shop and sell it to the Skull Kid in the Lost Woods.

masks.spooky_mask.where: Borrow it from the Happy Mask Shop and sell it to the boy in the graveyard.

masks.bunny_hood.where: Borrow it from the Happy Mask Shop and sell it to the running man in Hyrule Field.

masks.mask_of_truth.where: The Happy Mask Shop lends it once you've paid for the Bunny Hood.

bottles.potion_shop_bottle.where: In Castle Town, catch the bug that got away from the Potion Shop. New in the remake.

bottles.cucco_lady_bottle.where: The Cucco Lady in Kakariko gives it once you've brought all seven Cuccos back to her pen.

bottles.lon_lon_milk_bottle_talon.where: Talon's prize at Lon Lon Ranch for winning his Cucco game, once he's back home.

bottles.rutos_letter_bottle.where: Found underwater at Lake Hylia as a child. Show the letter to King Zora.

bottles.poe_collector_bottle.where: The Poe Collector in Castle Town's ruins gives it once you've sold him five Big Poes.

great_fairies.death_mountain_summit_magi.where: In the fountain behind the cracked wall on the Death Mountain summit. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She gives magic and Din's Fire. Her fee is 25 Rupees.

great_fairies.hyrule_castle_grounds_chil.where: In the fountain behind a boulder near Hyrule Castle, as a child. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She only appears once you have Din's Fire. Her fee is 50 Rupees.

great_fairies.zoras_fountain_farores_win.where: In the fountain behind a cracked wall in Zora's Fountain. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She only appears once you have Din's Fire. Her fee is 100 Rupees.

great_fairies.death_mountain_crater_doub.where: In the fountain behind a wall in Death Mountain Crater that the Megaton Hammer breaks. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She only appears once you have Din's Fire. Her fee is 200 Rupees.

great_fairies.desert_colossus_nayrus_lov.where: In the fountain behind a cracked wall at the Desert Colossus. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She only appears once you have Din's Fire. Her fee is 300 Rupees.

great_fairies.outside_ganons_castle_adul.where: In the fountain outside Ganon's Castle, behind a huge rock the Golden Gauntlets lift. Play Zelda's Lullaby. She only appears once you have Din's Fire. Her fee is 500 Rupees.

capacity.kokiri_wallet.where: You start with it. It holds 200 Rupees.

capacity.adults_wallet.where: The reward for 10 Gold Skulltula tokens. It holds 500 Rupees.

capacity.giants_wallet.where: The reward for 30 Gold Skulltula tokens. It holds 1,000 Rupees.

capacity.bomb_bag.where: Your first Bomb Bag, found in Dodongo's Cavern.

capacity.bigger_bomb_bag.where: Stop the rolling Goron in Goron City with a Bomb, as a child. If you've already won the Bombchu Bowling bag, this one is the biggest instead.

capacity.biggest_bomb_bag.where: A Bombchu Bowling prize. Whichever bag upgrade you get second is the biggest.

capacity.bigger_deku_seed_bag.where: Hit every target in the Lost Woods slingshot game, as a child.

capacity.biggest_deku_seed_bag.where: Win the Castle Town shooting gallery, as a child. Whichever seed bag upgrade you get second is the biggest.

capacity.bigger_quiver.where: Win the Kakariko shooting gallery, as an adult.

capacity.biggest_quiver.where: Score high at the Gerudo horseback archery range. Whichever quiver upgrade you get second is the biggest.

capacity.deku_stick_capacity_20.where: Buy it from the Business Scrub near the Lost Woods bridge, as a child.

capacity.deku_stick_capacity_30.where: Wear the Skull Mask on the Deku Theater stage in the Lost Woods.

capacity.deku_nut_capacity_30.where: Buy it from the Business Scrub in the Sacred Forest Meadow grotto that the Song of Storms opens.

capacity.deku_nut_capacity_40.where: Wear the Mask of Truth on the Deku Theater stage in the Lost Woods.

stones_medallions.kokiris_emerald.where: The Great Deku Tree gives it after you defeat Gohma.

stones_medallions.gorons_ruby.where: Darunia gives it after you defeat King Dodongo.

stones_medallions.zoras_sapphire.where: Princess Ruto gives it after you defeat Barinade.

stones_medallions.light_medallion.where: Rauru gives it in the Chamber of Sages when you first become an adult.

stones_medallions.forest_medallion.where: Saria gives it after you defeat Phantom Ganon.

stones_medallions.fire_medallion.where: Darunia gives it after you defeat Volvagia.

stones_medallions.water_medallion.where: Ruto gives it after you defeat Morpha.

stones_medallions.shadow_medallion.where: Impa gives it after you defeat Bongo Bongo.

stones_medallions.spirit_medallion.where: Nabooru gives it after you defeat Twinrova.

dungeons.great_deku_tree.where: Inside the Great Deku Tree, in Kokiri Forest.

dungeons.lord_jabu_jabus_belly.where: Inside Lord Jabu-Jabu, in Zora's Fountain. Give him a fish to get in.

dungeons.forest_temple.where: Beyond the Sacred Forest Meadow, as an adult.

dungeons.fire_temple.where: Inside Death Mountain Crater, as an adult.

dungeons.ice_cavern.where: In the frozen Zora's Fountain, as an adult. Finished when you get the Iron Boots.

dungeons.water_temple.where: At the bottom of Lake Hylia, as an adult.

dungeons.bottom_of_the_well.where: Under Kakariko's well, as a child, once the well is drained. Finished when you get the Lenses of Truth.

dungeons.shadow_temple.where: Below the graveyard, as an adult.

dungeons.spirit_temple.where: At the Desert Colossus, with parts for both ages.

dungeons.gerudo_training_ground.where: In Gerudo Fortress, as an adult with the Gerudo Membership Card. Finished when you get the Ice Arrows.

dungeons.ganons_castle.where: Where Hyrule Castle stood, as an adult with the Shadow and Spirit Medallions.

bosses.gohma.where: At the bottom of the Great Deku Tree.

bosses.king_dodongo.where: At the end of Dodongo's Cavern.

bosses.barinade.where: At the end of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

bosses.phantom_ganon.where: At the end of the Forest Temple.

bosses.volvagia.where: At the end of the Fire Temple.

bosses.morpha.where: At the end of the Water Temple.

bosses.bongo.where: At the end of the Shadow Temple.

bosses.twinrova.where: At the end of the Spirit Temple.

bosses.ganondorf.where: At the top of Ganon's Castle.

bosses.ganon.where: In the ruins of Ganon's Castle, the final battle.

mini_bosses.great_moblin.where: In the Sacred Forest Meadow, as an adult.

mini_bosses.poe_sisters.where: In the Forest Temple: the four sisters who took the torches' flames.

mini_bosses.white_wolfos.where: In the Ice Cavern, guarding the Iron Boots.

mini_bosses.dead_hand.where: At the bottom of the Bottom of the Well.

mini_bosses.gerudo_guards_carpenter_cell.where: The Gerudo guards at each carpenter's cell in Gerudo Fortress.

mini_bosses.iron_knuckle_nabooru.where: In the Spirit Temple: the Iron Knuckle that turns out to be Nabooru.

side_quests.malons_friend.where: At Lon Lon Ranch: learn Epona's Song from Malon as a child, then win Epona from Ingo as an adult.

side_quests.happy_mask_shopkeeper.where: In Castle Town: borrow masks from the Happy Mask Shop, sell them to their buyers and pay the shop back.

side_quests.to_the_great_fairy.where: Find the Great Fairy on the Death Mountain summit and receive magic and Din's Fire.

side_quests.stir_the_scarecrows_soul.where: At Lake Hylia: teach the scarecrow a tune as a child and play it back to him as an adult.

side_quests.from_a_pocket_egg_comes.where: The adult trading quest, from the Cucco Lady's Pocket Egg to Biggoron's Sword.

side_quests.broken_windmill_dry_well.where: In Kakariko: learn the Song of Storms in the windmill as an adult, then play it there as a child to drain the well.

big_poes.001.where: By the sign at the entrance of the ruined bridge in Hyrule Field.

big_poes.002.where: In the open field between Lon Lon Ranch and Hyrule Castle.

big_poes.003.where: At the entrance of Lon Lon Ranch, by the tree standing on the path.

big_poes.005.where: At the base of the hill that climbs up to Gerudo Valley.

big_poes.006.where: On the hill toward Gerudo Valley, at the spot closest to Lon Lon Ranch.

big_poes.007.where: In the woods just south of Lon Lon Ranch.

big_poes.008.where: In the field south of the crab-shaped watering hole.

big_poes.009.where: Just left (south) of the path leading into Kokiri Forest.

big_poes.010.where: In the field between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

skulltula_rewards.10_tokens_adults_walle.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, for 10 tokens.

skulltula_rewards.20_tokens_echo_gem.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, for 20 tokens.

skulltula_rewards.30_tokens_giants_walle.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, for 30 tokens.

skulltula_rewards.40_tokens_bombchus_20.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, for 40 tokens.

skulltula_rewards.50_tokens_piece_of_hea.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, for 50 tokens.

skulltula_rewards.100_tokens_gold_rupee_.where: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko, once all 100 tokens are in. Come back for more Rupees any time.

child_trade.weird_egg.where: Malon gives it outside Hyrule Castle. It hatches into a Cucco.

child_trade.wake_up_cucco.where: The Weird Egg's Cucco. Use it to wake Talon by the castle.

child_trade.zeldas_letter.where: Princess Zelda gives it in the castle courtyard. Show it to the guard at Kakariko's gate to Death Mountain.

adult_trade.pocket_egg.where: From the Cucco Lady in Kakariko, as an adult. It hatches overnight.

adult_trade.pocket_cucco.where: Hatched from the Pocket Egg. Wake Talon with it in Kakariko, then return it to the Cucco Lady.

adult_trade.cojiro.where: From the Cucco Lady. Take it to the man in the Lost Woods.

adult_trade.odd_mushroom.where: From the man in the Lost Woods. Take it to the old woman in Kakariko's Potion Shop before it spoils.

adult_trade.odd_potion.where: From the old woman in the Potion Shop. Take it to the girl in the Lost Woods.

adult_trade.poachers_saw.where: From the girl in the Lost Woods. Take it to the head carpenter in Gerudo Valley.

adult_trade.broken_gorons_sword.where: From the head carpenter in Gerudo Valley. Take it to Biggoron on the Death Mountain summit.

adult_trade.prescription.where: From Biggoron. Take it to King Zora in Zora's Domain.

adult_trade.eyeball_frog.where: From King Zora. Take it to the scientist at the Lakeside Laboratory before time runs out.

adult_trade.worlds_finest_eye_drops.where: From the Lakeside Laboratory scientist. Take them to Biggoron before time runs out.

adult_trade.claim_check.where: From Biggoron. Come back after a few days to collect his sword.
